We sincerely acknowledge the invaluable contributions of people living with dementia, family carers, community organisations, and aged care workers who have participated in the co-design and development of the iSupport-D program.
We also recognise the important role of dementia carers in Australia, Indonesia, New Zealand, and Vietnam, whose experiences helped inform the development of both the e-DiVA platform and iSupport-D.
We further acknowledge the valuable collaboration of our technology partners, who contributed to the design, development, and implementation of the iSupport-D platform, as well as the video production teams in Vietnam, whose work supported the creation of culturally relevant training and instructional content for the program.
